species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 10–44 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 75 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 115 ft, so fish stay above it.
North wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.
